name: Gorma, the Gullet
oracle_text:
Lifelink
Whenever another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Gorma.
Nontoken creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each creature that died under your control this turn.
blocked_sentences: Nontoken creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each creature that died under your control this turn.

needs.what: an enters_with_additional_counters static whose amount is the turn-ledger value {"creatures_died_this_turn": "you"} (creatures that died under the static controller's control this turn), read at the moment the nontoken creature enters, so a turn with no deaths adds nothing
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The static enters_with_additional_counters exists and its affects can say nontoken creatures you control ({controller: you, types: [Creature], is_token: false}), but the loader accepts only a whole number >= 1 or {count: <battlefield filter>} as its amount, and zones._additional_entering_counters evaluates only those two shapes. creatures_died_this_turn is in value_keys but not in static_value_keys, and a fixed amount or a battlefield count would add the wrong number of counters
